title: OutfitDef

takes_colors.description: The character's own colours its pieces take (AppearanceColorRoles: the skin tone, the hair colour, the job's cloth colour), where the theme's models are painted with them. Empty: the pieces keep their own colours.

slot.description: Outfit slot (OutfitSlots): equipment and job pieces of the equipment slots it covers are not drawn while this is.

model_asset_key.description: Piece model (model.*): attach or skinned in the theme manifest, like worn equipment.

gender.description: Gender it is for (Genders). Null: both.

items.description: One piece of an outfit: what is drawn in one slot.

pieces.description: Its pieces; the slots it covers are the ones that have a piece. At least one. A slot has one piece for everyone, or at most one per gender.

description: An outfit (T-708, ARCHITECTURE §7.5.2): something a character can own and show in place of its gear. It only ever changes how a character looks. There is no field here for a modifier, an effect, a requirement, a price or a drop, and none may be added: an unknown key is a load error, and no item, shop or drop table can name an outfit.
